changes:
Skip a sense period read after a startup probe already closed the speakers instead of panicking (Aurora's 0002, rebased on 3.0.0).
Try the machine's own configuration (apple/j575c.conf) before its family's (apple/j575.conf) (Aurora's 0003, rebased on 3.0.0).
notes: speakersafetyd 3.0.0 is 2.0.1 with Aurora's 0001 (the j504 speaker names) merged, a relicence to GPL-2.0-only and timestamps in its log; the model, the configuration format and every shipped model value are unchanged, so this build runs the same daemon as alarm-aurora's 2.0.1-1.2. Debian's librust-*-dev build dependencies do not resolve for a cross build (librust-configparser-dev:arm64 needs librust-async-std-1+default-dev:arm64, which has no installable candidate), so it is built emulated.
